title: Willet
summary: Raleigh names Willet in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Master Doctor Willet. The printed name was not expanded. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
